brief:
A 30-year-old man died Friday from injuries he sustained in a shooting incident that took place Wednesday, August 26, in Gaza City, the General Police Directorate announced. The victim had been hospitalized following the shooting but succumbed to his wounds two days later.

The police directorate provided no further details about the circumstances surrounding the incident or the identity of those responsible. The announcement came as Gaza continues to grapple with recurring incidents of armed violence affecting civilians in the territory.
